  • Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand or identify defined work problems and program goals, obtain prioritized deliverables, and discuss program impact.
  • Prioritize program goals, understand and translate other stakeholders’ needs into program goals and prioritized deliverables with minimal assistance, and contribute to decisions on prioritizing goals and deliverables.
  • Define the scope of projects and develop, execute, or manage project plans for supported program(s).
  • Review key metrics pertaining to a program, monitor potential metric deviations, and define corrective actions for critical deviations.
  • Identify, communicate, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders within one or more teams to drive impact and work toward mutual goals. Build, maintain and enhance business, operational, and management dashboards.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience in security assessments and network security.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Security experience, particularly in either threat modeling, application security, system management, OS hardening, or network security concepts (e.g., segmentation, protocols used for layering security capabilities).

title: Head of Product Deployment Engineering
descriptionHtml:
As the Product Deployment Engineering (PDE) Manager, you will be the strategic leader and primary link between gTech Ads, Google Customer Solutions (GCS) regional leadership, and PSA. You will unify these functions to graduate customers along the product adoption maturity curve. A critical mandate involves liaising with GCS PSA Leaders, Global Product Leads, and the Ads Solutions Engineering CoE to deploy excellent implementations. Your team will critically assesses customer needs to drive advanced product adoption.

You will serve as a product advocate for gTech Ads for complex technical product deployment. This role balances the operational management of a specialized technical team with the execution of high-impact, regional media and product business strategies.

Operationally, you will guide a high-performing team of Product Deployment Engineers (PDEs) through complex technical projects and advanced implementations. Strategically, you will act as the principal advisor to gTech Ads GCS, owning the complex implementation strategy across the region. You will partner with implementation program managers, PSA leads, and regional sales directors to accelerate product adoption.

You will act as a trusted advisor to align technical service delivery with media activation opportunities, balancing engineering support with sales targets and partner with global/regional product leaders and technical program managers to align resource allocation with market-specific goals, guide vendor execution, and provide technical mentorship to engineers. You will collaborate with Ads Solutions Engineering to drive the automation roadmap and development by delivering technical Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and prioritizing impact.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate gTech's value proposition into GCS sales strategies and adapt global/regional data activation strategies to meet localized market needs alongside PSA counterparts.
  • Oversee advanced implementations and custom CRM/API workarounds, while actively identifying scaling best practices to transition bespoke fixes into repeatable frameworks.
  • Partner with cross-cluster product communities and Ads Solutions Engineering (ASE) to define technical tooling requirements (BRDs) that automate and scale implementation delivery. Define best practices and work with agents to scale implementations.
  • Deploy scarce, high-value technical resources toward high-opportunity sectors, establishing robust metrics and case studies to quantify the business value delivered.
  • Manage, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of PDEs, fostering a high-impact, and entrepreneurial culture.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
  • 3 years of experience in people management.
  • Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
  • 15 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.
  • Experience building and maintaining internal and external stakeholder networks, with a track record of navigating complex corporate structures to deliver against strategic plans.
  • Knowledge of the online advertising/customer growth role and familiarity with the ad serving industry and internet technologies.
  • Ability to navigate highly ambiguous situations, solve complex technical or business problems, and scale solutions.

title: Senior IP Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, you will own the full verification life-cycle from verification planning and test execution to coverage closure, with an emphasis on meeting stringent AI/ML performance and accuracy goals, build constrained-random verification environments capable of exposing corner-case bugs and ensuring the reliability of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) workloads on Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) hardware. You will collaborate closely with design and verification engineers in active projects and perform verification.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Plan the verification of digital design blocks and interact with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
  • Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
  • Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
  • Measure to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
  • Create a constrained-random verification environment using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM).

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in Verification, verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) or ASICs.
  • Experience in verification and debug of IP/subsystem/SoCs in the networking domain such as packet processing, bandwidth management, congestion control.
  • Experience verifying digital systems using standard IP components/interconnects (e.g., microprocessor cores, hierarchical memory subsystems).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience with industry-standard simulators, revision control systems, and regression systems.
  • Experience in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) Accelerators or vector processing units.
  • Experience with the full verification life cycle.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

title: Software Engineer III, Search
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The AIGC Platform is the foundational infrastructure responsible for the entire lifecycle of AI-generated content (AI Overviews and AI Cards), including LLM-based topic ingestion, content clustering, summary generation, quality evaluation, and publishing. Our platform enables product teams to rapidly develop and experiment with new AI-first formats, transforming the Discover feed into a dynamic, AI-powered knowledge and entertainment companion. We ensure that AI-generated content is fresh, factual, grounded, and safely delivered to millions of users globally by integrating rigorous automated quality gates and efficient LLM agentic workflows. By centralizing AIGC creation, we enable optimizing heavy compute resources and streamlining the pipeline from real-world events to personalized user feeds and notifications.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain robust and scalable backend infrastructure, data pipelines, and software solutions for the AIGC Platform.
  • Build scalable, low-latency, and high-throughput streaming and batch data pipelines to handle massive content ingestion, clustering, deduplication, and publishing to serving indexes.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Product Managers, UX, Data Scientists, Quality teams and downstream Ranking/Retrieval teams, to drive technical designs and unblock new AI content use cases.
  • Analyze and optimize system performance, pipeline latency, monitor service health, and manage compute capacity to ensure operational excellence.
  • Make independent technical contributions and deliver on end-to-end tasks within the platform's broader transformation goals.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., C++ or Python).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Experience building, maintaining, and scaling high-performance, data-intensive distributed backend systems and data processing pipelines.
  • Experience with frameworks and tools relevant to AI/ML development, LLM inference, agent-based architectures, and generative AI deployment.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, content recommendation systems, search technologies, or information retrieval.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a track record of thriving in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, and excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple specialized engineering and product teams.

title: Senior Silicon Physical Design Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a Physical Design Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the functional design, Design For Testing (DFT), architecture, and packaging engineers. Additionally, you will solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic circuits solutions, while evaluating design options with optimized performance, power, and area in mind.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the implementation of physical design methodologies.
  • Take ownership of one or more physical design partitions or top level.
  • Manage timing and power consumption of the design.
  • Contribute to design methodology, libraries, and code review.
  • Define the physical design related rule sets for the functional design engineers.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with advanced design, including clock/voltage domain crossing, design for testing (DFT), and low power designs.
  • Experience with system on a chip (SoC) cycles.
  • Experience in high-performance, high-frequency, and low-power designs.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience in coding with System Verilog and scripting with TCL.
  • Experience with layout verification and design rules.
  • Experience with very large scale integration (VLSI) design in SoC or multiple-cycles of SoC in ASIC design.

title: Director, Security Defense Platforms
descriptionHtml:
As the Director of Security Defense Platforms, you will lead the global software engineering organization responsible for the foundational software, streaming pipelines, telemetry architectures, and AI-driven automated containment infrastructure that powers all of Alphabet’s detection and response operations.

In this role, you will be an executive engineering leader with experience building massive-scale distributed data systems, driving high-reliability platform engineering, and advocating advanced security automation and agentic defense. You will bridge software engineering with cyber defense partnering closely with Detection and Response domain leads, and enterprise platform teams to transform Google’s security posture from reactive "Detect and Respond" to proactive "Infer and Interrupt".

Additionally, you will manage, grow, and mentor a globally distributed organization of Software Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers across multiple global sites. You will own the long-term architectural road map for the Detection and Response teams core infrastructure. You will lead the engineering and deployment of automated threat containment (e.g., automated mitigation pipelines, and dynamic endpoint mitigation) to disrupt high-risk access abuse, workspace DLP, and intrusion attempts in real-time. You will drive the integration of AI models and agentic reasoning into operational workflows, automating alert triage, incident summaries, and investigative workflows. You will ensure platform reliability, multi-region resilience, and SLO compliance, reducing operational toil and on-call burden to established target of engineering bandwidth.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Foster a high-performance engineering culture emphasizing technical aptitude, operational excellence, and continuous architectural innovation.
  • Deliver large-scale resource optimization initiatives, drastically reducing global data storage and compute footprints while maintaining strict end-to-end detection latencies.
  • Institutionalize configuration-based detection frameworks that cut authoring and productionization cycles down to industry-leading velocity.
  • Advocate for novel defense mechanisms for autonomous third-party agent security, data leakage mitigation, and federated access auditing.
  • Deliver against executive and board-level cyber security risk reduction commitments.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cyber security, or equivalent practical experience
  • 15 years of software engineering and technical leadership experience, including 6 years of experience managing managers and leading multi-site engineering organizations
  • Experience partnering with security operations, threat intelligence, or incident response teams to build developer and detection platforms
  • Experience using modern AI/ML applications in cyber security including automated reasoning, LLM-based agent evaluation, anomaly detection, and synthetic threat injection/watermarking

Preferred qualifications:

  • 20 years of experience in software engineering, distributed systems, or enterprise platform infrastructure, with experience in cyber security or threat defense domains
  • Experience architecting Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), SIEM, EDR data fabrics, or real-time event correlation engines
  • Experience designing, building, and operating distributed streaming pipelines, query engines, and high-throughput data processing systems operating at enterprise/hyper-scale
  • Experience with cross-functional leadership and executive presence to translate deep architectural challenges into clear business and security risk decisions for VP/SVP stakeholders
  • Expertise in infrastructure cost optimization, data lifecycle/retention governance, and high-availability streaming SLO management

title: Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, Google Cloud Platforms, Infrastructure Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Google's custom-designed machines make up one of the largest and most powerful computing infrastructures in the world. The Hardware Testing Engineering team ensures that this cutting-edge equipment is reliable. In the R&D lab, you design test equipment for prototypes of our machinery and develop the protocols used to scale these tests for the entire global team. Working closely with design engineers, you give input on designs to improve our hardware until you're sure it meets Google's standards of quality and reliability.

As a Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, you will evaluate the product designs and create the manufacturing test processes, tools and procedures behind the products powering Google’s Data Centers, Google Cloud and Google’s Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning. When vendors build parts for our infrastructure, you are right there alongside ensuring manufacturing test processes are repeatable and controlled. You will collaborate with Commodity Managers and Design Engineers to determine Google’s infrastructure needs and product specifications. Your work will ensure the various pieces of Google’s infrastructure fit together perfectly and keep our systems humming along smoothly for a seamless user experience.

You will be expected to travel internationally up to 20% of the time as needed.

Our Platforms Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds the
hardware and software technologies that power all of Google's services. Our computational challenges are complex and unique, enabled by cutting-edge custom hardware designed and made in-house. As a hardware engineer, you will design and build the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. You will see those systems from concept all the way through to high-volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our cutting-edge data centers, affecting millions of Google users.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $144000 - $208000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive manufacturing test development for new and existing product designs. Architect and write test software to drive end-to-end test coverage based on product and quality requirements.
  • Develop automated test scripts for functional and system tests, software installation using Python.
  • Design, build, and deploy test platforms for Google's global manufacturing partners.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and root cause manufacturing yield issues and field escapes. Drive issues to closure with preventive measures.
  • Define the manufacturing test strategy for new products and work with our partners to jointly develop the required test solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience as a Manufacturing Test, Quality, Reliability, or Product Engineer.
  • 8 years of experience developing manufacturing test solutions for PCBAs and computer systems.
  • 6 years of experience developing or integrating manufacturing test hardware using custom electronics, fixtures and instrumentation and using Python for automation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10 years of experience in manufacturing tests and software development using Python.
  • Experience with creating end-to-end manufacturing test strategies from structural through functional and system tests.
  • Experience with architecting complex manufacturing test solutions for high-performance compute-based products (i.e., GPUs).

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người kiến tạo sự tăng trưởng chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, mang lại giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động nhằm thúc đẩy sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác. Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ vận dụng tư duy nhạy bén trong kinh doanh để xác định, định hướng và thu hút khách hàng bằng các giải pháp Hiệu suất dựa trên AI của Google (Tìm kiếm). Bạn sẽ cung cấp dịch vụ khách hàng, nghiên cứu và phân tích thị trường theo chuẩn của Google, đồng thời dự đoán cách đưa ra quyết định, thấu hiểu những điểm khác biệt tinh vi của từng chiến dịch, cũng như không ngừng tìm tòi và khám phá nhu cầu của các lĩnh vực kinh doanh chủ chốt. Cùng với khách hàng, bạn sẽ đặt ra mục tiêu và chiến lược để quảng cáo của họ có thể tiếp cận người dùng một cách hiệu quả nhất.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Duy trì mối quan hệ bền chặt với khách hàng, công ty quảng cáo và các bên liên quan trọng yếu khác để đảm bảo phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh và thúc đẩy hợp tác thành công.
  • Thiết kế và giới thiệu các giải pháp mang tính đột phá, dựa trên dữ liệu (Tìm kiếm dựa trên AI) phù hợp với nhu cầu của khách hàng. Tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và kỹ năng kể chuyện lôi cuốn để xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều, thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh thu.
  • Chỉ đạo thực thi các sáng kiến chiến lược để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng và tăng doanh thu cho các giải pháp hiệu suất dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), từ đó đổi mới hoạt động quảng cáo của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích và tối ưu hoá Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI) tiếp thị bằng cách theo dõi và đánh giá hiệu suất của các chiến dịch dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), đưa ra các đề xuất dựa trên dữ liệu để không ngừng cải thiện.
  • Nắm bắt các xu hướng và cải tiến trong ngành tiếp thị kỹ thuật số, cung cấp thông tin chi tiết và đề xuất chủ động để đảm bảo đội ngũ và khách hàng luôn dẫn đầu trong bối cảnh không ngừng thay đổi.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc có kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo, tư vấn bán hàng hoặc phát triển kinh doanh.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng cả tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh để làm việc với các bên liên quan trong nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm thúc đẩy thay đổi và phối hợp với nhiều bên liên quan.
  • Có kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án liên chức năng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm trong ngành trò chơi.
  • Có kinh nghiệm thiết lập mối quan hệ và bán hàng cho các bên liên quan ở cấp điều hành.
  • Am hiểu về các hoạt động và mô hình kinh doanh truyền thông liên chức năng.
  • Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.

title: Regional Enablement Lead (English, Japanese)
descriptionHtml:
The Japan Regional Enablement Lead (REL) acts as a partner to the Japan Office of the President, COO and Chief of Staff. You will be the critical link between global enablement strategy and regional execution, responsible for supporting the priorities across Japan.

title: Senior GPU Performance Software Engineer, AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Machine Learning (ML)-Omega team is responsible for optimizing, modeling, and evaluating GPU systems for comparative analysis and benchmarking for Google’s internal ML workloads. We strive for extracting maximum efficiency in Google’s GPU fleet, evaluating current and future ML workloads to guide decision-making for the Cloud hardware teams.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and maintain Large Language Model (LLM) training and serving benchmarks that are representative of Google production, industry, and the ML community, using them to identify performance opportunities, drive Accelerated Linear Algebra (XLA) Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)/Triton performance, and guide XLA releases.
  • Engage with Google product teams like DeepMind to solve their ML model performance problems, such as onboarding new LLM models and products on GPU hardware and enabling LLMs to train and serve efficiently at a very large scale.
  • Run architecture-level simulations on GPU designs and perform roofline analysis to guide internal teams.
  • Analyze performance and efficiency metrics to identify bottlenecks, as well as design and implement solutions at Google fleet-wide scale.
  • Run performance benchmarks on GPU hardware using internal and external tools.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 5 years of experience with machine learning algorithms and tools, artificial intelligence, deep learning, or natural language processing.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • Experience with hardware/compiler co-design or high-performance computing (HPC).
  • Experience in performance analysis and debugging, improving performance of single-node or multi-node (distributed) systems.
  • Experience in GPU programming using CUDA or Triton kernels (or Palace/Mosaic kernels).
  • Background in Compiler optimizations or related fields would also be beneficial.

title: Program Manager III, Logistics Capacity Planning, Cloud Logistics
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

The Google Cloud Logistics (GCL) Capacity Planning team ensures the operational readiness and scalability of Google's global logistics network. In this role, you will own end-to-end capacity planning, transforming demand forecasts into executable operational plans. You will bridge supply chain strategy and on-the-ground execution by designing and owning the quantitative models that govern network flow, storage, throughput, and labor. You will use SQL, data pipelines, and analytical models to simulate sourcing changes, stress-test network capacity (e.g., space, dock throughput, labor), and run scenarios to balance workloads. You will establish and lead planning cycles, including regional Demand-Supply Reviews (DSR) with Operations and third-party logistics (3PL) partners, integrating commitments into monthly S&OP/D&OP processes. You will also partner with Engineering and Product teams as a subject matter expert to codify business logic and network constraints into automated, scalable planning tools.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Build network flow and distribution models across upstream suppliers, regional fulfillment hubs, and destination data centers; evaluate sourcing rule changes, lane realignments, and routing adjustments to assess downstream capacity impacts and balance network workload.
  • Establish and govern repeatable capacity planning processes, planning calendars, and forecast lock cycles from the ground up, embedding warehouse and data center capacity plans into monthly S&OP/D&OP cycles, rolling commits, and quarterly/annual budgeting.
  • Own key forecast health metrics, including plan-vs-actual variance and forecast accuracy/bias (WAPE, MAPE), driving root-cause analysis and continuous calibration of the underlying models and parameters that enable constraint planning.
  • Design, build, and own forecasting and capacity models that enable constraint planning across GCL global warehouses and data centers, translating upstream supply chain and deployment schedules into multi-horizon plans across storage space, dock throughput, and labor.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program or project management.
  • Experience in developing forecasting models and scripting in SQL.
  • Experience in logistics, logistics capacity planning, network modeling, constraint planning, or demand forecasting.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building and owning end-to-end quantitative logistics capacity, network, constraint, or forecasting models across warehousing, distribution centers, data center operations, or hardware supply chains.
  • Expertise in physical logistics capacity and distribution planning, modeling network flows, sourcing rule changes, storage footprint, dock throughput, and labor capacity across short and long-term horizons.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or statistical modeling tools to build capacity pipelines, simulate network/sourcing changes, analyze plan-vs-actual variances, and improve forecast accuracy (WAPE, MAPE, Bias).
  • Define business logic, sourcing rules, and functional requirements that integrate and automate manual planning models into internal logistics capacity planning tooling.

title: Financial Accountant
descriptionHtml:

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:

  • Ability to lead and drive complex operational initiatives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. Experience of business partnering with strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.

title: Data Center Technician II
descriptionHtml:

title: Research Lab Manager, Quantum AI
descriptionHtml:
Google's custom-designed machines make up one of the largest and most powerful computing infrastructures in the world. The Hardware Testing Engineering team ensures that this cutting-edge equipment is reliable. In the R&D lab, you design test equipment for prototypes of our machinery and develop the protocols used to scale these tests for the entire global team. Working closely with design engineers, you give input on designs to improve our hardware until you're sure it meets Google's standards of quality and reliability.

As a Research Lab Manager, you will have experience overseeing daily lab operations with a focus on coordinating facility build outs and implementing safety programs. You will be responsible for maintaining the robust and varied facilities for quantum computers, with a focus on HVAC, electrical, power, cleanroom performance, and building modifications. You will also ensure equipment is serviced in accordance with manufacturer’s guidelines and in compliance with relevant permits. You will prioritize tasks while communicating with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, and often interface with local municipalities, contractors, research scientists, engineers and EHS teams.

Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.
